sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claims"."Policy_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST(("Claims"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claims"."Amount_Settled") AS REAL) / "Claims"."Amount_Settled")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Claims" GROUP BY "Claims"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claims.relative difference of amount claimed from amount settled
why: (amount claimed - amount settled) / amount settled: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of amount claimed from amount settled per Customer_Policies (by Policy_ID)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of amount claimed from amount settled (all level)
